calculate_tier.title: Find out the guest's priority
calculate_tier.subtitle: 3 quick questions, no guessing
calculate_tier.q1_title: Do you want them there no matter what?
calculate_tier.q1_desc: That person who can't be missing
calculate_tier.q2_desc: Not just history, but also the present
calculate_tier.q3_desc: Sometimes one of you wants them there no matter what and the other doesn't as much — tell us separately
calculate_tier.q4_title: Is there outside pressure or obligation to invite them?
calculate_tier.q4_desc: Sometimes you invite out of obligation, not just closeness
calculate_tier.level_1_desc: It would be nice, but it's not a priority
calculate_tier.level_2_desc: It would add to the event, though it's not essential
calculate_tier.level_3_desc: I want them there if possible
calculate_tier.level_4_desc: They can't be missing under any circumstance
calculate_tier.q2_level_2: We see each other once in a while
calculate_tier.q2_level_4: They're part of my everyday life
calculate_tier.q2_level_1_desc: The relationship is more in the past than in the present
calculate_tier.q2_level_2_desc: There's contact, but it's not frequent
calculate_tier.q2_level_3_desc: We see or talk to each other regularly
calculate_tier.q2_level_4_desc: We talk or hang out all the time
calculate_tier.q3_level_3: It does matter to me that they're there
calculate_tier.q3_level_4: For me, they have to be there no matter what
calculate_tier.q4_level_2: Some would be expected, but it wouldn't be a big deal if not
calculate_tier.q4_level_3: There would be comments if we don't invite them
calculate_tier.q4_level_4: It's a real obligation (immediate family, a commitment already made, etc.)
calculate_tier.q4_level_1_desc: No one outside the two of you has a say in this
calculate_tier.q4_level_2_desc: Someone might expect it, but nothing bad would happen
calculate_tier.q4_level_3_desc: There could be comments or awkwardness if they're missing
calculate_tier.q4_level_4_desc: A commitment or bond already exists that makes it hard to skip
calculate_tier.cat_a: A must — top priority if the list needs trimming.
calculate_tier.cat_b: An important guest, but not essential.
calculate_tier.cat_c: Could be left out if space is very limited.
calculate_tier.cat_d: Low priority compared to other guests.
calculate_tier.cat_a_tagline: The kind you notice the moment they're missing.
calculate_tier.cat_a_desc: It's not just affection — it's real closeness, today. You both agree: they have to be there no matter what. If the guest count gets tight, this person isn't even part of that conversation.
calculate_tier.cat_a_note: Give them a special spot — they're probably part of the inner circle on the day itself.
calculate_tier.cat_b_tagline: You want them there, but the world won't end if they can't make it.
calculate_tier.cat_b_desc: There's real interest in having them there. But there's also some room: maybe the closeness has faded a bit, or one of you feels it more than the other.
calculate_tier.cat_b_note: If the list needs trimming, this one's worth a second look before deciding.
calculate_tier.cat_c_tagline: Nice to have, but the event doesn't depend on it.
calculate_tier.cat_c_desc: Maybe it's a different chapter now, or the relationship lives more in memory than in the present. There's nothing wrong with that.
calculate_tier.cat_c_note: If space is tight, this is where you can trim without it feeling like a snub.
calculate_tier.cat_d_tagline: Not everyone needs a spot on the list, and that's okay.
calculate_tier.cat_d_desc: Little closeness today, no real obligation, zero comments if they don't come.
calculate_tier.cat_d_note: The lowest-cost cut on the list starts here.

guests_tour.welcome_desc:
We redesigned guest management: instead of a table, it's now a step-by-step journey.

🗺️ This step bar is the map:

• Overview — your summary of everything
• Steps 1 to 3 — each guest's journey, from the waiting list to their table
• Aside — those who won't attend

We'll walk you through it block by block. In a hurry? Skip to the next block anytime 👇
guests_tour.ov_today_desc:
Your to-do list, already prioritized. Whatever needs your attention shows up here:

🔴 Failed sends
🟡 People who read but haven't replied
📞 Phone numbers to fix

Each row has its own button to solve it right away.
guests_tour.ov_pie_desc:
The donut shows how your list breaks down.

• Change the segmentation: status, tag, priority, table...
• Tap a slice (or its row) to filter
• With active filters, a "See list" button shows the resulting guests
guests_tour.ov_progress_desc:
Confirmations per day over the last two weeks.

At a glance you know if the pace is picking up 🚀 or if it's time for reminders 🔔
guests_tour.ov_mesas_desc:
A summary of your table map:

• How many confirmed guests already have a seat
• How full each table is

From here you can open the map to arrange them.
guests_tour.ov_funnel_desc:
The funnel follows your guests from created to confirmed.

If a stage looks much shorter than the previous one, that's where people are getting stuck 👀
guests_tour.block_creado_desc:
This is where it all starts: your waiting list. ✨

👥 Who's here?
The guests you've created but who haven't received their invitation yet.

🎯 The goal of this step:
Get their invitation to them — via WhatsApp from the platform, or by sharing their personal link yourself.
guests_tour.rsvp_deadline_desc:
This banner asks you to set how long your guests can confirm.

• It matters: without a deadline you can't send reminders 🔔
• Once set, it becomes a discreet line under the search box, with "Change" in case you move it
guests_tour.search_desc:
Each section has its own search box.

Type a name and the list filters instantly — it also finds companions inside groups.
guests_tour.new_guest_desc:
From here you add new people:

• One by one, with the form 📝
• Or import your full list from Excel 📊
guests_tour.more_tools_desc:
What used to live in the top bar is now here:

📥 Download your lists as Excel
🗺️ Open the table map
🔒 Make the event public or private
🎫 The pass scanner
guests_tour.copy_link_desc:
Every guest has their own personal invitation link.

This button copies it so you can share it anywhere you like — the main guest and each companion have their own.
guests_tour.send_invitation_desc:
Send the invitation via WhatsApp in one click.

• Uses your credits and requires a Mexican number 🇲🇽
• Sent it yourself with the link? Mark the guest with the check ✓
guests_tour.mark_sent_desc:
Did you send the invitation yourself (WhatsApp, text, in person)?

This check moves them to "Waiting for reply" without spending credits.
guests_tour.block_esperando_desc:
Your event's waiting room. ⏳

👥 Who's here?
Those who already received their invitation but haven't confirmed or declined yet.

🎯 The goal of this step:
Make sure nobody goes unanswered — here you track deliveries and reads, and send reminders.
guests_tour.alert_failed_desc:
When a WhatsApp send doesn't go through, this red banner warns you with the count.

Find those guests in the list and retry the send from their card. 🔁
guests_tour.alert_read_desc:
This banner gathers everyone who opened their invitation but hasn't answered.

They're the best candidates for a reminder 🔔
guests_tour.retry_desc:
Cards with a failed send show this button:

• It retries the send to the same number
• Was the phone the problem? Fix it first by opening the card ✏️
guests_tour.remind_desc:
For anyone who still hasn't replied:

• Send a WhatsApp reminder in one click
• Needs a deadline set 📅 and available credits
• The little number shows how many reminders they've received
guests_tour.block_confirmado_desc:
The best part! 🎉

👥 Who's here?
Those who already said yes — each one takes up a pass of your event.

🎯 The goal of this step:
Make sure everyone has a seat: assign tables from each card or open the full map.
guests_tour.table_action_desc:
Each confirmed guest has their table action:

• No table → the button lets you pick one right here
• Has a table → you see their table number

To seat everyone at once, open the map from the banner above 🗺️
guests_tour.quick_no_table_desc:
One tap and the list shows only the confirmed guests still without a table.

In other words: exactly what you have left to arrange. ✅
guests_tour.filters_desc:
Filter by tag, table, priority, category or side.

• They combine with each other and with the search box
• The counter reminds you how many are active
guests_tour.block_rechazado_desc:
The aside block.

👥 Who's here?
Those who declined the invitation.

💡 They don't take up passes or table seats — your capacity is freed up for someone else. And if anyone changes their mind, they're always at hand.
guests_tour.replay_desc:
That's it! 🎉

You can rewatch this walkthrough anytime with this "?" button.

Have a great event ✨

side_tour.welcome_desc:
We redesigned side events. Everything now lives in two modes:

🎨 Design — how the piece looks
📨 Send — who you send it to

We'll walk you through both, block by block.
side_tour.canvas_desc:
What you see here is what your guest sees when they open the link: same background, same fonts, same cards.

Tap anything to edit it. The title and the notes are typed right on top.
side_tour.background_desc:
The image behind everything. It shows in full at the top and blurs where the details begin.

Tap the background on the piece and its bar appears on top: image or video, color veil and the link image.
side_tour.color_desc:
It tints the gradient and every card on the piece. It's what sets the mood.

It lives in the Design panel, together with the veil and the effects.
side_tour.title_desc:
The event name is typed right on the piece.

Tap it and this bar changes its font, size, weight, line height, opacity and shadow.
side_tour.date_desc:
The time you pick is exactly what your guests will see: it is never converted to any time zone.

Tap the date on the piece to change it here.
side_tour.place_desc:
The venue name and the map address.

The search fills in the fields for you. With a complete address the "How to get there" button appears, and with a city the day's weather can be shown.
side_tour.notes_desc:
Dress code, directions, whatever is needed.

It goes in its own card at the end of the piece and is typed right on top. Anything between *asterisks* shows in bold.
side_tour.live_desc:
Swaps the editing canvas for the published piece, inside an iPhone, an iPad or a Mac.

Use it to check the final result before sharing the link.
side_tour.share_desc: This is where you copy the link you'll send. Before copying you can choose the image that shows in the WhatsApp preview.
side_tour.save_desc:
Design changes are not saved automatically.

While something is pending you'll see a red dot on the button, and we'll warn you if you try to leave.
side_tour.block_envio_desc:
This is the other mode: your guest list for this side event, separate from the main event's.

While you're here, the piece on the left shows as published.
side_tour.steps_desc:
The ladder is the map:

• Step 1 — haven't received their invitation yet
• Step 2 — got it and haven't replied
• Step 3 — confirmed
• Aside — not attending

Tap each step to see who's there.
side_tour.deadline_desc: Set how long they have to confirm. Without a deadline you can't send WhatsApp reminders.
side_tour.search_desc: By name or number. It searches the whole list, not just the step you have open.
side_tour.filters_desc: Filter by tag and by priority. The tags are this side event's, not the main event's.
side_tour.add_guest_desc:
Three ways:

• Copy from the main event's list — the fastest
• One at a time
• By uploading your spreadsheet
side_tour.cards_desc:
One per block: the lead guest and their companions go together, because the invitation is sent complete in a single WhatsApp.

Each card carries its actions: copy their link, mark it as sent, retry or remind.
side_tour.elements_desc:
PNGs with a transparent background (flowers, frames, logos…) that go over the cover.

Drag them from here onto the piece, or paste them with ⌘V. Pick one on the piece and its bar adjusts it.
side_tour.layers_desc: Your PNGs, the topmost first. Drag a row to change the order and use the eye to hide one without deleting it.
side_tour.dock_desc: Undo and redo (also with ⌘Z), the switch between Edit and Live view, the devices and the zoom.
side_tour.replay_desc: That's it. If you want to see this again, this button replays it any time.

tables_tour.welcome_desc:
This is where you lay out the tables as they'll be on the day and seat everyone who has confirmed.

You don't have any tables yet, so we're showing you a sample venue. Nothing you see here is saved.
tables_tour.add_desc:
Tables —round or rectangular— and venue elements come from here: dance floor, bar, stage.

Every table starts with a number and a size you can change later.
tables_tour.table_desc:
Drag it to move it around the floor plan.

Tap it to open its panel: rename it, change its shape, set how many seats it has, and add or remove guests.

Filled chairs are taken seats; outlined ones are free.
tables_tour.guests_desc:
This column is everyone who said yes and doesn't have a table yet.

Drag one onto a table on the plan to seat them.
tables_tour.progress_desc:
The strip sums up your progress: how many are seated, how many are left and how many seats you have to spare.

If something looks off, it takes you straight to the table list.
tables_tour.views_desc:
The map answers "what does my venue look like?" and the list "who's at each table?".

The list also lets you sort by number, by emptiest first, or by the ones that still have room.
tables_tour.auto_desc:
Rearranges every table at once using one of three layouts.

Great for getting started; you can move things by hand afterwards.
tables_tour.center_desc: If you get lost panning around, this button brings you back to the center at the zoom where the whole venue fits.
tables_tour.tools_desc:
Zoom in and out, the hand to pan around, and undo and redo.

Nothing you try is final: you can always take the last move back.
tables_tour.replay_desc:
That's it. When you close this, the sample venue disappears and you start with your own.

This button replays the tour any time.
tables_tour.welcome_desc_own:
This is where you lay out the tables as they'll be on the day and seat everyone who has confirmed.

Here's a reminder of what each part of the floor plan does.
tables_tour.replay_desc_own: That's it. This button replays the tour any time.

std_tour.welcome_desc:
It's the piece that announces the date before the formal invitation: a single screen, no RSVP and no guest list.

It has two views:

🎨 Create — how it looks
💬 Replies — who reacted
std_tour.canvas_desc:
What you see here is what anyone opening your link will see.

Tap anything to edit it, and type the title right on top.
std_tour.background_desc:
It can be a photo carousel or a video.

This is where you upload them, reorder them and decide whether the image darkens or blurs so the text reads better.

With video you also need a still image: it's the one that shows in the WhatsApp preview.
std_tour.title_desc:
"Save the date", your names, whatever you want to say.

You type it right on the piece; here you change its font, color, size and where it sits.
std_tour.date_desc:
This is what drives the countdown: the days, hours and minutes left are calculated from here.

You can change its font and color too.
std_tour.button_desc:
The one that downloads the calendar reminder for whoever opens it.

The color is translucent and blends over the photo, which is why there are suggested tints.
std_tour.song_desc:
Search Spotify or upload a file.

It plays when they open the piece, and its cover art shows in the corner.
std_tour.live_desc:
Swaps the editing canvas for the published piece, inside a phone.

Use it to check the final result before you share the link.
std_tour.when_desc: It tells you how far ahead you should send the Save the Date based on your event date.
std_tour.link_desc: The link you'll send. It's public: anyone who has it can open it, react and save the date.
std_tour.save_desc:
Changes are not saved automatically.

While something is pending you'll see a red dot on the button, and we'll warn you if you try to leave.
std_tour.answers_desc:
Reactions and messages from everyone who opened your piece land here, live.

They don't have to be registered guests: anyone with the link can reply.
std_tour.replay_desc: That's it. This button replays the tour any time.

build_tour.welcome_desc:
This bar is the index: each icon is a module of your invitation.

Here's what each one is for 👇
build_tour.generals_desc:
The style of the whole invitation: color palette, fonts, textures and separators.

Whatever you change here applies to every section.
build_tour.cover_desc: The first thing your guest sees: background image, title, event date and the song that plays on open.
build_tour.greeting_desc: A title and a short paragraph to welcome your guests and tell them what the event is about.
build_tour.family_desc:
Who's with you: parents, godparents, bridesmaids, groomsmen...

You add each person with their name and role.
build_tour.quote_desc: A phrase or verse over a background image. It works as a visual pause between sections.
build_tour.itinerary_desc:
The moments of your event: ceremony, reception, party...

Each one with its time, address and map.
build_tour.dresscode_desc: The dress code: description, suggested color palette, reference images and your Pinterest board.
build_tour.gifts_desc: Your gift options, each one as a card: bank accounts or registries in online stores.
build_tour.destinations_desc: Useful if your event is out of town: hotels, restaurants and recommended activities, each with its link.
build_tour.notices_desc: Short, important notes: adults-only event, parking, RSVP deadline...
build_tour.gallery_desc: Your favorite photos. They show at the end of the invitation.
build_tour.editor_desc:
When you pick a module, its form shows up here.

Everything you type or change is reflected instantly.
build_tour.undo_desc: Reverts your last change. It also works with Ctrl/Cmd + Z.
build_tour.redo_desc:
Re-applies what you just undid.

It only shows up when there is something to redo.
build_tour.devices_desc: Switch the preview phone to check how your invitation looks on each system.
build_tour.images_desc: The invitation's album: upload your photos and videos once and reuse them in any module.
build_tour.translate_desc:
Add another language and we translate the invitation for you.

From here you switch between versions or re-translate.
build_tour.zoom_desc: Zoom the preview in or out. You can also drag the phone to move it around.
build_tour.preview_desc:
This is how it looks live on your guest's phone: every change shows up instantly.

When you like it, publish it from the button above. Done! 🎉
